description: Editorial broadsheet aesthetic — cream paper, warm ink, masthead red, high-contrast serif type.

Intro.bio: This is an example of a “newspaper” type of theme for my portfolio. All features within each theme are driven by a JSON file, this paragraph among them. I built this portfolio to demonstrate my expertise in multi-tenant platform configuration and accessible design, as I am very interested in full-stack engineering opportunities that extend deep front-end architecture into end-to-end product work.
Intro.tagline: Software engineering: News Edition. Reliable delivery, careful editing, coverage that scales.
